questions.question: where is gradebook and how i use it?
questions.answer: The course gradebook is accessed from the navigation bar at the top right corner of your Blackboard Ultra course; click the Gradebook icon to open it. Once opened, the gradebook (populated with enrolled students) lets you grade coursework, manage items, and post grades using either the List View or the Student Grid View, which you can switch with the toggle button on the top left of the page.

questions.question: hey i need to post an announcement for my class on blackboard, how?
questions.answer: To post an announcement, go to **Details & Actions** and select **Create Announcements**; click the plus sign at the top right, enter the title, recipients, and message, optionally check “Send an email copy to recipients” or schedule it, then click **Save** (to keep a draft) and finally click **Post** to make it visible to students.

questions.question: how do grades get from blackboard into banner at the end of term
questions.answer: Faculty members enter grades electronically into Blackboard, which then forwards the grades automatically to the registration system (Banner); instructors can also use the Grade Transfer Dashboard to locate the course, view details, and transfer the grades after chair and dean approval.
